about_the_game: Dead On Duty: Red Dawn offers you a unique sandbox to expand upon with over 25 firearms, 4 melee weapons, 13 perks and 11 map! Play as a mercenary to survive against endless hordes of undead in the chaotic world of Dead On Duty: Red Dawn!

content_descriptors.notes: The violence depicted in the game is in line with aesthetic of the game and thus depicted in a stylistic way rather than a realistic way.

detailed_description: Dead On Duty: Red Dawn offers you a unique sandbox to expand upon with over 25 firearms, 4 melee weapons, 13 perks and 11 map! Play as a mercenary to survive against endless hordes of undead in the chaotic world of Dead On Duty: Red Dawn!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3130 / AMD Athlon x4 750
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD HD 7000 series / NVIDIA 600 series (Driver: Mesa 21+ / NVIDIA 470+)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard audio
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX 6300
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon R9 380 / NVIDIA GTX 960 (Driver: Mesa 21+ / NVIDIA 470+)
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard audio

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4-core) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5000 / AMD Radeon HD 7000 series (Metal compatible)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard audio
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 (Monterey)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (quad-core) or Apple M1/M
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon R9 M380 / Apple M1 GPU or better (Metal compatible)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard audio
